name: ro-array-core-power-extracted
description: Issue #17's post-layout re-run of sim/tb/ro-array-core-power/ against layout/pex/ro_array_core.extracted.spice (klt extract --parasitics over drawn leaf cells, composed per design/ro_array_core.spice topology -- see layout/pex/build.py). Same DUT topology/rails/measurement expressions as the pre-layout testbench; only device-level parasitics differ. Active-power claim of issue #14, re-derived at the binding worst corner post-layout.
tstep: 1p (print step; ngspice's own LTE sets the actual solver step)
analyses: meas tran t1a when v(ro1)=v(vth) rise=2
meas tran t1b when v(ro1)=v(vth) rise=6
meas tran t2a when v(ro2)=v(vth) rise=2
meas tran t2b when v(ro2)=v(vth) rise=6
meas tran c1a find v(q1) when v(ro1)=v(vth) rise=2
meas tran c1b find v(q1) when v(ro1)=v(vth) rise=6
meas tran c2a find v(q2) when v(ro2)=v(vth) rise=2
meas tran c2b find v(q2) when v(ro2)=v(vth) rise=6
meas tran cta find v(qt) when v(ro1)=v(vth) rise=2
meas tran ctb find v(qt) when v(ro1)=v(vth) rise=6
meas tran vhi max v(ro1) from=25n to=48n
meas tran vlo min v(ro1) from=25n to=48n
meas tran vxhi max v(xo) from=25n to=48n
meas tran vxlo min v(xo) from=25n to=48n
caveats: Post-layout, device-level-parasitic-annotated (layout/pex/build.py); NOT a full assembled-ring/inter-region routing extraction -- see layout/pex/build.py's own module docstring and sim/characterization-post-layout-extracted.md for exactly what this does and does not capture.

Scoped to the single corner sim/characterization-startup-and-power-budget.md identified as binding for active power (ff/-40 C/3.63 V), per issue #17's acceptance criteria ('spec table confirmed at the worst corner post-layout'), not the full grid.
